setup_registry: setup a new registry with a name, optional base class, default value, and required flag
build_x_from_config: build an instance from a DictConfig, string choice, or Namespace using the registry's build function
register_x_decorator: register a class in the registry using the register_x decorator with an optional dataclass
register_x_with_dataclass: register a class with an associated MetaseqDataclass that stores config in Hydra ConfigStore
access_REGISTRIES_dict: access the global REGISTRIES dictionary to inspect all registered registries and their dataclass registries
